INCOTERMS 2020
Term Full Name Risk Transfer Who Pays Freight Best For
EXW Ex Works At seller's factory gate Buyer pays everything Buyer has own forwarder; domestic pickup
FCA Free Carrier When handed to carrier Buyer pays from named point Container shipments; replaces FOB for containers
FOB Free On Board When goods cross ship's rail Buyer pays ocean + destination Taiwan machine tool exports — most common
CFR Cost and Freight When loaded on vessel Seller pays ocean freight Seller arranges shipping, buyer arranges insurance
CIF Cost, Insurance & Freight When loaded on vessel Seller pays freight + min. insurance Seller controls shipping; buyer may want own insurance
DAP Delivered at Place At named destination Seller pays all to destination Door-to-door; buyer handles import duties
DDP Delivered Duty Paid At buyer's premises Seller pays everything incl. import duty Maximum seller responsibility; rare in machine tools

TAIWAN EXPORT — COMMON PRACTICE
Most Common
FOB Taichung / Kaohsiung
Standard term for Taiwan machine tool exports. Seller delivers to port, buyer arranges ocean freight and insurance from there.
Note
FOB vs FCA for Containers
Technically FCA is more accurate for containerized cargo (risk transfers at CFS/CY), but FOB remains widely used in practice by Taiwan exporters.
Marine Insurance
Under FOB — Who Insures?
Under FOB, the buyer is responsible for insurance. The seller may optionally arrange marine insurance as an added service.

KEY MARKETS

Z&Z STROTEC exports worldwide — wherever there is no appointed local agent yet, we can supply you directly. The countries below are simply the key markets we have profiled in detail. 🟢 Full Service markets have local sales & after-sales agents; 🔵 Parts Supply markets receive components and spare parts. Don't see your country? Just ask.

🟢 Full Service
🇰🇷 Northeast Asia
South Korea
Major importer of Taiwan CNC machine tools. Strong demand in automotive, aerospace, and precision parts sectors.
🟢 Full Service
🇧🇷 South America
Brazil
⚠️ 2026 Tariff Increase: Brazilian government added ~10% additional duty on CNC machine tool imports — total landed cost now approximately 70–80%+. Port: Santos. Strong automotive & industrial base, high potential but import costs are significant.
🟢 Full Service
🇨🇭 Europe
Switzerland
Precision engineering hub. Low tariffs. High demand for grinding, precision turning. Very high quality standards.

SIMI permit system. Currency controls. Growing retrofit and spare parts market. USD transactions preferred.

Fastest-growing SEA manufacturing hub. Samsung, Intel FDI driving CNC demand. 0% import duty. High growth potential.

Thailand
SEA's largest auto manufacturing hub. Toyota, Honda, Isuzu presence. BOI duty exemptions available.

Largest SEA economy. Making Indonesia 4.0 initiative. Automotive, electronics, mining sectors. Local agent recommended.
🔵 Parts Supply

Malaysia
Semiconductor, E&E, aerospace MRO. English business environment. 0% duty for machine tools.
🔵 Parts Supply
🇮🇳 South Asia
India
🔥 High Growth Potential | World's 4th largest machine tool consumer. Make in India + PLI schemes. ~28–30% landed cost. Booming demand driven by automotive & aerospace supply chain reshoring.
🔵 Parts Supply
🇵🇱 Eastern Europe
Poland
Central Europe's largest manufacturer. VW, Toyota, Fiat auto clusters. EU market access. CE marking required.
🔵 Parts Supply

Czech Republic
Skoda/VW, Toyota, Hyundai. High precision demand. Among highest per-capita machine tool use in emerging Europe.
🔵 Parts Supply

Turkey
Bridge market between Europe and Middle East. Booming defense sector. Automotive: Ford, Toyota, Renault. USD/EUR contracts preferred.
🔵 Parts Supply
🇺🇸 North America
United States
World's largest machine tool import market; Taiwan's #2 destination. MFN ~4.4%; since 24 Jul 2026 the Section 301 forced-labour tariff caps the all-in rate at 10%, non-stacking. NFPA 79 / NRTL certification. 480V 60Hz.
🔵 Parts Supply

Mexico
Nearshoring boom. Top-10 global auto producer. IMMEX duty-free import. Monterrey, Guanajuato industrial clusters.

3rd largest South American economy. Oil & gas, metalworking. Growing Medellín tech sector.

Saudi Arabia
Vision 2030 industrialization. NEOM giga-projects. Oil & gas MRO. 5% duty. USD-pegged currency. Strong growth outlook.

🇦🇪 Middle East
UAE
Re-export hub via Jebel Ali. Oil & gas, aerospace (Strata). 5% duty, 5% VAT. AED pegged to USD. Gateway to MEA & South Asia.

Aerospace (Montreal), auto parts (Ontario), oil & gas (Alberta), mold & die. Mostly 0% duty. GST 5%. CSA electrical cert. EN/FR.

Mining equipment, defense, agriculture. Machine tools mostly 0% duty. GST 10%. RCM mark, AS/NZS safety. Long transit — consolidate.
🔵 Parts Supply
🇩🇪 Europe
Germany
World's top machine-tool maker — supply components & subcontract parts, not whole machines. EU ~2.7% duty, 19% VAT. CE + rigorous docs.
🔵 Parts Supply

Europe's #2 machine-tool producer & big consumer. Industrial districts (Emilia-Romagna, Lombardy). EU ~2.7% duty, 22% VAT. CE required.

WHAT'S NEW  ／  最新消息  ／  최신 소식
2026.08
Expert Column: Ageing CNC Machines, How to Read Component Life Ratings and Build a Spare Parts Strategy Around Them
務實面對設備老化：CNC 關鍵零件壽命評估與備品庫存策略 ／ 설비 노후화에 대한 현실적 접근: CNC 핵심 부품 수명 평가와 예비품 재고 전략
A catalogue life figure is a travel distance that 90% of a group of identical units reach before fatigue flaking, calculated against a reference distance that is not always 50 km. The new column sets out the life equation and the exponent that differs between ball and roller types, explains why a larger C value in one catalogue can simply mean a different reference basis, and separates true brinelling from particle denting and false brinelling, since each points at a different fix. It then turns to what to act on with linear guides and spindles, why a fixed replacement year is weaker than a baseline record, and how to tier spares by downtime impact, lead time, substitution difficulty and storage risk rather than by price.
Expert Column
2026.08
Knowledge Library: Spindles, rewritten around selection, acceptance and troubleshooting

Adding a feeder to a machine already on the floor is a different exercise from buying one with a new lathe, and the new column works through what has to be settled first. Bar capacity is set by the smallest of the spindle bore, the draw tube inner diameter and the chuck through-hole, not by the turning diameter in the catalogue. Whether the machine has a feeder interface at all depends on the options taken when it was originally purchased rather than on its age, so the original specification settles the question faster than opening the cabinet. The spindle liner that keeps the bar supported inside the bore is a machine-side part, is rarely in the feeder quotation, and is the usual reason a retrofit never reaches its intended speed. 🇺🇸 Trade Update — US Tariff Reset: Taiwan Now Capped at an All-In 10% (Section 301, from 24 July 2026)
美國關稅制度更迭：台灣自 2026/7/24 起適用 301 條款，合計上限 10% ／ 미국 관세 제도 변경: 대만 2026.7.24부터 301조 적용, 합산 10% 상한
The 15% reciprocal rate is no longer in force. After the Supreme Court ruled in February 2026 that IEEPA does not authorise tariffs, and the Section 122 stopgap lapsed, the US moved to a Section 301 forced-labour tariff covering 60 economies from 24 July 2026. Taiwan is in the top tier alongside the EU: MFN and Section 301 duties combined are capped at an all-in 10% and are not stacked, so a CNC machine tool at 4.4% MFN lands at 10% total, against a 12.5% cap for Japan, South Korea and Switzerland. Section 232 goods (steel, aluminium, copper and derivatives, vehicles and parts, wood, semiconductors) are exempt from the Section 301 duty. The United States market profile and the Import Duty Reference have both been updated; rates have moved repeatedly through 2026, so confirm your HTS code with a customs broker in writing before quoting.

歡迎廠商刊登產品資訊 & 業務合作洽詢

萬洋國際有限公司（Z&Z STROTEC）經營一個面向國際市場的工具機知識平台，服務對象涵蓋全球工具機市場的進口商、工程師及採購人員。刊登合作不限工具機相關產業，舉凡工具機零組件、精密零件、CNC 周邊、倉儲設備、油冷氣設備、高壓液壓系統、氣壓元件，或任何與製造業相關的產品與服務皆歡迎洽詢。

合作方式

BANNER 廣告欄位
在相關知識文章頁面刊登公司 Logo 及簡短產品說明，全站訪客可見。

✦ 所有刊登內容須經萬洋國際審核，確保符合平台專業定位。
✦ 費用及合作形式依個案洽談，歡迎先來信索取媒體資料（Media Kit）。
✦ 適合廠商類型（不限）：車床廠、料機廠、刀具廠、零組件供應商、CNC 控制器、倉儲設備、油冷氣設備、高壓系統、氣壓元件等工業相關產品皆可。

刊登原則

贊助內容會以清楚的方式與知識庫文章區隔呈現。這是為了維持讀者對平台的信任——讀者相信這裡的內容，您的曝光才有價值。實際的呈現形式與版位規劃相當有彈性，歡迎來信就個案討論。

ABOUT US  ／  關於我們

Z&Z STROTEC CO., LTD. · 萬洋國際有限公司

Founded in 2002, Z&Z STROTEC is a Taiwan-based trading partner for CNC machine tools, bar feeders, precision parts and components — based in Tanzi District, Taichung, in the heart of Taiwan's precision-machinery corridor. We connect international buyers with the right Taiwanese manufacturers and support the entire process from inquiry to delivery, in English, 中文 and 한국어.

萬洋國際成立於 2002 年，座落於台灣精密機械走廊核心的台中潭子，是 CNC 工具機、送料機、精密零件與零組件的貿易夥伴。我們為國際買家媒合合適的台灣製造廠，並以英文、中文、韓文三語，協助從詢價到交機的完整流程。

2002년 설립된 Z&Z STROTEC은 대만 정밀기계 산업의 중심지인 타이중 탄쯔구에 위치한 CNC 공작기계·송료기·정밀 부품 무역 파트너입니다. 해외 바이어와 적합한 대만 제조사를 연결하고, 영어·중국어·한국어로 견적부터 납품까지 전 과정을 지원합니다.

How it started

We did not set out to build a knowledge website. It began with answering customers' technical questions by email — which Incoterm to quote, whether a part will fit a machine already on the floor, what the destination country's power supply and certification will demand. After explaining the same things hundreds of times, it was clear that writing them down once, in the three languages we work in, would reach far more manufacturers than the one who happened to ask.

我們原本並沒有打算做一個知識網站。一切是從用 email 回覆客戶的技術問題開始的——該報哪個貿易條件、某個零件裝不裝得上既有機台、目的國的電源和認證會要求什麼。同樣的內容解釋過上百次之後才發現，與其一封一封回，不如用我們工作的三種語言寫下來一次，能幫到的就不只是當下問問題的那一位。

처음부터 지식 사이트를 만들려던 것은 아니었습니다. 이메일로 고객의 기술 질문에 답하는 데서 시작되었습니다 — 어떤 인코텀즈로 견적을 낼지, 부품이 이미 설치된 장비에 맞을지, 도착국의 전원과 인증이 무엇을 요구하는지. 같은 내용을 수백 번 설명하고 나서야, 한 건씩 답하기보다 저희가 쓰는 세 가지 언어로 한 번 정리해 두는 편이 훨씬 더 많은 제조사에 도움이 되겠다는 것을 알게 되었습니다.

Why we built this library

There is no shortage of information about CNC machine tools, but most of it sits scattered across separate websites, manufacturers' technical documents and forums. In our experience helping customers in Taiwan and overseas, answering a single question often means working through several sources and cross-checking them against each other. What we wanted to build was a CNC knowledge library worth trusting — one place where you can find the answer, understand why it is the answer, and see what to do about it.

We are not a manufacturer and we do not own a factory. What we do is judge which Taiwanese builder is right for a given part, and stay on the file until the machine is running. In Korea, Brazil, Switzerland and Argentina that includes installation and after-sales through our local agents; in other markets we supply parts and components — and we say so, rather than promising service we cannot deliver.

市面上關於 CNC 工具機產業的資訊其實不少，但大多分散在不同網站、品牌技術文件與論壇之中。依我們過去協助國內外客戶的經驗，很多人為了找到一個問題的答案，往往需要花不少時間查閱不同來源、交叉比對資訊。我們希望建立一個值得信賴的 CNC 知識庫，讓您在同一個網站就能找到答案、理解原因，並找到可行的解決方法。

我們不是製造廠，也沒有自己的工廠。我們做的是判斷哪一家台灣廠適合這個件，並且跟到機器順利運轉為止。在韓國、巴西、瑞士、阿根廷，這包含透過在地代理的安裝與售後；其他市場我們供應零件與零組件——這一點我們也會直說，不承諾做不到的服務。

CNC 공작기계에 관한 정보 자체는 적지 않습니다. 다만 대부분이 서로 다른 웹사이트, 제조사 기술 문서, 포럼에 흩어져 있습니다. 국내외 고객을 지원해 온 경험상, 질문 하나의 답을 찾기 위해 여러 출처를 뒤지고 서로 대조하는 데 적지 않은 시간이 듭니다. 저희가 만들고자 한 것은 믿을 수 있는 CNC 지식 라이브러리입니다. 한 사이트 안에서 답을 찾고, 왜 그런지 이해하고, 실행 가능한 해결 방법까지 확인하실 수 있도록 하는 것입니다.

저희는 제조사가 아니며 자체 공장도 없습니다. 저희가 하는 일은 해당 부품에 맞는 대만 제조사를 판단하고, 장비가 정상 가동될 때까지 건을 놓지 않는 것입니다. 한국·브라질·스위스·아르헨티나에서는 현지 에이전트를 통한 설치와 애프터서비스가 포함되며, 그 외 시장에서는 부품과 구성품을 공급합니다. 할 수 없는 서비스를 약속하지 않고 그대로 말씀드립니다.

PRIVACY POLICY  ／  隱私權政策  ／  개인정보 처리방침

Last updated / 最後更新 / 최종 수정: 2026-08-06

ENGLISH

This policy explains what personal data Z&Z STROTEC CO., LTD. (萬洋國際有限公司) collects through this website, why we collect it, how long we keep it, and how you can have it removed. We are the data controller.

Who we are

Z&Z STROTEC CO., LTD. (萬洋國際有限公司)
13F.-2, No. 135, Sec. 2, Zhongshan Rd., Tanzi Dist., Taichung City 42755, Taiwan (R.O.C.)
Company Registration No.: 80235084
Tel: +886-4-2534-1660
Contact: info@zz-strotec.com

What we collect, and why

  • Inquiry form — name, company, email, country and the details you write in the message field. We use this only to answer your inquiry and to quote. Legal basis: steps taken at your request prior to entering into a contract.
  • Newsletter form — your email address, used only to tell you when we publish a new Expert Column or a significant Knowledge Library update. Legal basis: your consent.
  • Google Analytics 4 — pages viewed, approximate location derived from IP, device and browser type. We use this to see which articles are actually read. In the EEA, the UK and Switzerland this is switched off until you accept it in the banner at the bottom of the page. Legal basis: your consent.

We do not sell personal data, we do not use it for advertising or profiling, and we do not run remarketing.

Who processes it on our behalf

  • Formspree — delivers the inquiry form to our mailbox.
  • Mailchimp (Intuit) — stores the newsletter list and sends the emails.
  • Google (Analytics 4) — website statistics, only after consent where consent is required.
  • GitHub Pages — hosts this site and keeps standard server logs.

These providers process data outside Taiwan, including in the United States. Transfers rely on the providers' own standard contractual clauses.

How long we keep it

  • Inquiries: 3 years from our last exchange with you, so we can pick up a returning enquiry with its history. Inquiries that lead to an order are kept for 7 years, as export and accounting records require.
  • Newsletter: until you unsubscribe. Every email carries an unsubscribe link, and unsubscribing removes you from the list.
  • Google Analytics: 14 months, then deleted automatically.

Your rights

If you are in the EEA, the UK or Switzerland, you can ask us for a copy of your data, ask us to correct or delete it, object to its use, or withdraw consent at any time. Write to info@zz-strotec.com and we will reply within 30 days. You also have the right to complain to your national data protection authority.

To withdraw analytics consent after accepting it, clear this site's data in your browser — the consent banner will appear again on your next visit.

Cookies

This site sets no cookies of its own. Google Analytics sets its own cookies, and only once you have accepted. Your choice is stored locally in your browser, not on our server.

수집 항목 및 목적

  • 견적 문의 양식 — 이름, 회사명, 이메일, 국가 및 문의 내용. 문의 회신과 견적 제공에만 사용합니다. 법적 근거: 계약 체결 전 귀하의 요청에 따른 조치.
  • 뉴스레터 양식 — 이메일 주소. 새 전문가 칼럼이나 주요 지식 자료 업데이트를 알리는 용도로만 사용합니다. 법적 근거: 동의.
  • Google Analytics 4 — 조회 페이지, IP 기반 대략적 지역, 기기·브라우저 정보. 어떤 글이 실제로 읽히는지 파악하는 데 사용합니다. EEA·영국·스위스에서는 하단 배너에서 동의하기 전까지 작동하지 않습니다. 법적 근거: 동의.

당사는 개인정보를 판매하지 않으며, 광고·프로파일링·리마케팅에 사용하지 않습니다.

수탁 처리자

  • Formspree — 문의 양식을 당사 메일함으로 전달.
  • Mailchimp (Intuit) — 뉴스레터 명단 보관 및 발송.
  • Google (Analytics 4) — 웹사이트 통계. 동의가 필요한 지역에서는 동의 후에만 작동.
  • GitHub Pages — 사이트 호스팅 및 일반 서버 로그 보관.

위 사업자는 미국을 포함한 대만 국외에서 데이터를 처리하며, 국외 이전은 각 사업자의 표준계약조항에 따릅니다.

보유 기간

  • 문의 내역: 마지막 연락일로부터 3년. 주문으로 이어진 건은 수출·회계 법령에 따라 7년.
  • 뉴스레터: 수신 거부 시까지. 모든 메일에 수신 거부 링크가 포함되며, 거부 시 명단에서 삭제됩니다.
  • Google Analytics: 14개월 후 자동 삭제.

귀하의 권리

EEA·영국·스위스에 계신 경우 데이터 사본 요청, 정정·삭제 요청, 이용 거부, 동의 철회를 언제든 요청하실 수 있습니다. info@zz-strotec.com 으로 연락 주시면 30일 이내에 회신드립니다. 각국 개인정보 감독기관에 민원을 제기할 권리도 있습니다.

분석 동의를 철회하시려면 브라우저에서 본 사이트의 데이터를 삭제해 주십시오. 다음 방문 시 동의 배너가 다시 표시됩니다.
